title: 第2章 只为伊人
content_zh:
赵硕心头一酸，低头默默的吃饭，低头的瞬间，赵硕分明看到楚秀眼中闪过的泪光。

不知道为什么，赵硕脑海之中竟然没有关于父亲的一点记忆，不过赵硕也没放在心上，毕竟他得到的记忆有很多都遗失了，记不起也没什么好奇怪的。

赵硕将饭碗一推，看着轻嚼慢咽，朴素端庄的楚秀道。

楚秀微微一笑道：“你大哥去海边了，他要打捞海鱼挣钱，不然你和小鸾怎么进行星图开窍”

一旁的赵鸾撇了撇小嘴道：“母亲，城里面的那些商人都是拿普通的传承星图进行开窍，如此一来修行速度却是比那些人级传承星图进行开窍的人慢了许多，更不要说地级、天级还有传说中的荒古传承星图了”

听了赵鸾的话，楚秀苦笑道：“我家鸾儿心气傲着呢，可是进行星图开窍最佳的年龄段是在十岁至十六岁之间，超过十六岁的话，周身窍穴就会慢慢的老化拥堵，越发的难以贯通，你们的资质并没有好到让那些宗门接收的程度，娘亲也不想你们进行大众化的开灵窍，可是娘亲却没有能力……”

说着楚秀眼中晶莹的泪珠滚落，赵硕见了心中一颤，忙道：“母亲，您不用自责的，像大哥那样进行普通的星图开窍也没有什么的啊，只要努力修炼，也不是没有变强的希望，再说命里有时终须有，命里无时莫强求，一切随缘吧！”

赵鸾见状忙道：“母亲，您别伤心，鸾儿不过是说说而已，二哥说的对，该怎么样，命里注定了的！”

好不容易劝住了楚秀，赵硕与赵鸾帮着收拾了碗筷便被楚秀催着出了家门。

赵鸾脸上带着一丝自责道：“二哥，刚才都怪我不好，如果不是因为我的话，娘亲也不会那么自责了”

赵硕拍了拍赵鸾的脑袋笑了笑道：“傻丫头，别那么说，就是二哥也经常想着能够得到地级甚至天级的传承星图来开灵窍，可是咱们不是那些古老的世家和宗门，没有那个命的”

赵鸾听赵硕这么一说，吐了吐舌头脆声道：“原来二哥也经常做白日梦啊”

赵硕只是微微一笑，心中却是不平静，虽然记忆残缺不全，甚至对于这个世界没有什么清晰的了解，但是赵硕也能够想到那星图传承对于一个有志修炼的人的重要性。

在赵硕看来那传承星图开灵巧，所开灵窍的大小同样有等级的划分，就算是天赋异禀，所开灵窍却奇差无比，就像是让一个天才修炼下九流的秘籍，想来成就也不会高到哪里去。

而这里的传承星图就相当于一种可以改变先天资质的存在，甚至可以说比那所谓的秘籍还要珍贵许多，因为只有得到传承星图开灵窍，灵窍大开方才能进行修炼，将会拥有莫大的能力，翻江倒海、腾云驾雾、摩星拿月，长生不死根本就不在话下。

模模糊糊的明白这些之后，原本还有些不太在意的赵硕心跳不由的加速，脑海之中不禁幻想着有朝一日成为亘古不朽的存在，尤其是一点让赵硕心动不已，那就是只要变得强大起来，肯定能够找到回去的办法。

“青蝉，我的青蝉，就算是为了你，我也会想办法成为强大的存在，只为能够再闻一闻你的味道，看一看你的笑容，听一听哪怕是唠叨声也好……”

忽然之间，赵硕感觉自己被人推了一下，从沉思之中回过神来，回归现实的赵硕不禁心中苦笑，看来自己并不是没有欲望啊，不然的话怎么会想着得到强大的星图开窍，竟然白日做梦起来。

“二哥，你嘀咕什么呢，什么青蝉啊？”

赵鸾没有多问，眼睛一亮道：“咱们到了！”

赵硕抬头看去，只见一片古朴的院落正出现在面前，不少像他们这般大小的少年正陆续的走进一处处的小院中，赵硕明白，这里就是学堂了吧。

凭借着记忆，赵硕走进学馆之中，坐在自己的座位之上，没有过多久，学馆之中坐无空席，一名老者飘然而来，当从赵硕身边经过的时候，赵硕不禁精神一振，只见这老者轻飘飘的，如同鬼魅一般，脚踏虚空，竟然足不沾地的走过。

这是何等的本事，虽然了解到这里的人进行修炼会强大无匹，可是没有见到总有一种不真实的感觉，但是现在一名老者就在自己的面前足踏虚空而过，带给赵硕的绝对是触及灵魂的震撼，让赵硕深刻的明白这是一个何等神奇的地方。

“故老相传，荒古世界乃上古神人开辟，本源大陆为天眷顾之福地，大陆其大无边，星空无尽，正应天圆地方之说……”

听到这里，赵硕不由的噗嗤一声笑了起来，天圆地方，作为天文学科的硕士生，若是连天圆地方的说法是对是错都不清楚的话，那岂不是枉自读了那么多年的书。

微微的摇了摇头，怜悯的看了一眼诧异的看着自己的同学，虽然这里的人通过修炼可以变得强大无比，但是仍然像地球古时的那些人一般不知道脚下的大地其实是圆的吧。

站在那里的老者被赵硕的笑声打断，充满睿智的目光落在赵硕的身上道：“赵硕，方才为何无故发笑，难道老夫有什么地方讲的不对吗？”

同赵硕不对付的陈天贵不禁讥笑道：“夫子，赵硕方才无故发笑，颇为无礼，当逐出学馆，以正风纪”

赵硕闻言不由的皱了皱眉头，本来同陈天贵之间的纠葛是过去那个赵硕的事情，他并不怎么在意，但是如今陈天贵如此的咄咄*人，竟然想要夫子将自己逐出学馆，用心当真险恶，虽然他也没有继续深造下去的打算。

深吸一口气，赵硕看着夫子道：“夫子，赵硕并非无故发笑、目无尊长”

夫子微微点头道：“既如此，你且说来，方才为何发笑？”

赵硕正色道：“夫子岂不知天圆地方之说乃是大大的谬论吗，虽然看似大地平坦一片，但是这大地其实乃是一个圆球而已……”

赵硕在那里一本正经的解说着，好像是要将众人带出迷茫的智者一般却不料听了赵硕的话，众人脸上露出古怪的神色，只见陈天贵看傻子似地看着赵硕，接着哈哈大笑起来，一边大笑一边拍着面前的桌子道：“难不成赵硕的脑袋进水了不成，怎么说出这般的胡话来，谁不知本源大陆其大无边无际，上古无数道主陨落，遗骸所化山川大陆并入本源大陆，或许其他的星辰之上天圆地方是错的，可是在本源大陆，天圆地方却是再正确不过的至理名言”

这时赵硕察觉到众人那种看傻子似地目光不禁脸上火辣辣的，老天，这个鬼地方真是不可以常理看待，只怪自己没有得到这方面的记忆，不然也不用丢这么大的人了。

如此常识性的东西想来谁都知道吧，自己如今所犯的错如就如同在地球上，一个人在课堂上当着老师还有学生的面说脚下的大地是方的。

那啥，新书期间啊，收藏养着吧，有票积极的砸
content_en:
Zhao Shuo felt sad and lowered his head to eat silently. The moment he lowered his head, Zhao Shuo clearly saw the tears flashing in Chu Xiu's eyes.

For some reason, Zhao Shuo didn't have any memory about his father in his mind, but Zhao Shuo didn't take it to heart. After all, many of the memories he had gained were lost, so it wasn't surprising that he couldn't remember it.

Zhao Shuo pushed his rice bowl and looked at the simple and dignified Chu Xiudao who was chewing slowly.

Chu Xiu smiled slightly and said: "Your eldest brother has gone to the beach. He wants to salvage sea fish to make money. Otherwise, how will you and Xiaoluan perform star map enlightenment?"

Zhao Luan on the side curled his lips and said: "Mother, the merchants in the city all use ordinary inheritance star charts to enlighten their minds. As a result, their cultivation speed is much slower than those who use human-level inheritance star charts to enlighten themselves, let alone earth-level, heaven-level and the legendary ancient inheritance star charts."

After listening to Zhao Luan's words, Chu Xiu smiled bitterly and said: "My Luan'er is very proud, but the best age for star chart enlightenment is between the ages of ten and sixteen. If you are over sixteen years old, the acupoints all over your body will slowly age and become congested, making it more difficult to penetrate. Your qualifications are not good enough for those sects to accept them, and my mother does not want you to perform popular spiritual enlightenment, but she does not have the ability..."

As the crystal tears rolled down from Chu Xiu's eyes, Zhao Shuo trembled in his heart when he saw it, and hurriedly said: "Mother, you don't have to blame yourself. It's okay to perform ordinary star chart enlightenment like my elder brother. As long as you practice hard, there is no hope of becoming stronger. Besides, there is a time in life, and there is no time in life. Don't force it, just let everything go!"

Seeing this, Zhao Luan hurriedly said: "Mom, don't be sad, Luan'er is just talking, second brother is right, what should happen, it is destined!"

After finally persuading Chu Xiu, Zhao Shuo and Zhao Luan helped clear away the dishes and then were urged out of the house by Chu Xiu.

Zhao Luan said with a trace of self-blame on his face: "Second brother, you blamed me just now. If it weren't for me, my mother wouldn't blame herself so much."

Zhao Shuo patted Zhao Luan's head and smiled and said: "Silly girl, don't say that. Even my second brother often thinks about getting earth-level or even heaven-level inheritance star charts to open his spiritual aperture, but we are not those ancient aristocratic families and sects, and we don't have that fate."

When Zhao Luan heard what Zhao Shuo said, he stuck out his tongue and said crisply: "It turns out that second brother also often daydreams."

Zhao Shuo just smiled slightly, but his heart was not at peace. Although his memory was incomplete and he did not even have a clear understanding of the world, Zhao Shuo could also think of the importance of the star map inheritance for a person who is aspiring to practice.

In Zhao Shuo's view, the inherited star map is very clever, and the size of the spiritual orifices opened is also divided into levels. Even if he is extremely talented, the spiritual orifices he opens are very different. It is like a secret book that allows a genius to practice to the ninth level, and his achievements will not be that high.

The inherited star map here is equivalent to an existence that can change the innate qualifications. It can even be said to be much more precious than the so-called secret book, because only by getting the inherited star map to open the spiritual aperture and the spiritual aperture can be opened to practice, you will have great abilities.

After vaguely understanding this, Zhao Shuo, who was still a little unconcerned, could not help but speed up his heartbeat. He couldn't help but fantasize about becoming an immortal existence one day. Especially one thing that made Zhao Shuo excited was that as long as he became stronger, he would definitely be able to find a way back.

"Qingchan, my Qingchan, even for you, I will find a way to become a powerful existence, just to be able to smell your scent again, see your smile, and listen to even your nagging..."

Suddenly, Zhao Shuo felt like he was being pushed. He came out of his deep thoughts and returned to reality. Zhao Shuo couldn't help but smile bitterly in his heart. It seemed that he didn't have any desires. Otherwise, why would he be thinking about getting a powerful star map to enlighten him, and he would be daydreaming.

"Second brother, what are you muttering about? What about green cicada?"

Zhao Luan didn't ask any more questions, his eyes lit up and he said, "We're here!"

Zhao Shuo looked up and saw a quaint courtyard appearing in front of him. Many teenagers of their size were walking into the small courtyards one after another. Zhao Shuo understood that this was the school.

Relying on his memory, Zhao Shuo walked into the academy and sat on his seat. Not long after, there were no empty seats in the academy, and an old man floated over. When he passed by Zhao Shuo, Zhao Shuo couldn't help but perked up. He saw the old man floating lightly, like a ghost, stepping on the void, and walking without even touching the ground.

What kind of ability is this? Although I know that the people here will be extremely powerful if they practice, it always feels unreal if they don't see it. But now an old man is walking through the void in front of him. What he brings to Zhao Shuo is definitely a shock that touches his soul. Zhao Shuo deeply understands what a magical place this is.

"According to legend, the ancient world was opened by ancient gods and men. The original continent is a blessed land blessed by heaven. The continent is boundless and the starry sky is endless, which corresponds to the theory of a round sky and a square earth..."

Hearing this, Zhao Shuo couldn't help but laugh. As a master's student in astronomy, if he didn't even know whether the theory of a round sky and a square place was right or wrong, wouldn't he have wasted all those years of studying.

He shook his head slightly and glanced pityingly at his classmates who looked at him in surprise. Although the people here can become extremely powerful through practice, they are still like those people in ancient times who did not know that the earth under their feet is actually round.

The old man standing there was interrupted by Zhao Shuo's laughter. His wise eyes fell on Zhao Shuo and said: "Zhao Shuo, why were you laughing for no reason just now? Is there something wrong with what I said?"

Chen Tiangui, who was not dealing with Zhao Shuo, couldn't help but sneer and said: "Master, Zhao Shuo just laughed for no reason, which is quite rude. He should be expelled from the school to improve the discipline."

Zhao Shuo couldn't help but frowned when he heard this. Originally, the dispute with Chen Tiangui was a matter of the past Zhao Shuo, and he didn't care much about it. But now Chen Tiangui is so aggressive that he actually wants his master to expel him from the school. His intentions are really sinister, although he has no plans to continue his studies.

Taking a deep breath, Zhao Shuo looked at the Master and said: "Master, Zhao Shuo is not laughing without reason or disrespectful."

The master nodded slightly and said, "In that case, tell me, why were you laughing just now?"

Zhao Shuo said seriously: "Master, don't you know that the theory of a round sky and a square earth is a huge fallacy? Although it seems that the earth is flat, the earth is actually just a round ball..."

Zhao Shuo explained there seriously, as if he was trying to lead everyone out of a confused wise man, but unexpectedly listened to Zhao Shuo's words. Everyone had strange looks on their faces. Chen Tiangui looked at Zhao Shuo like a fool, and then burst out laughing. While laughing, he patted the table in front of him and said, "Is it possible that Zhao Shuo'sHow can you say such nonsense when your head is filled with water? Who doesn’t know that the Origin Continent is boundless. Countless Taoist masters have fallen in ancient times, and the mountains and rivers where their remains have been merged into the Origin Continent. Maybe it is wrong to say that the sky is round and the place is round on other stars, but in the Origin Continent, the sky is round and the place is round. It is the most correct maxim."

At this time, Zhao Shuo noticed that everyone was looking at them like they were looking at fools and couldn't help but his face was burning. God, this ghost place really cannot be treated with common sense. It's only his fault that he didn't get the memory of this, otherwise he wouldn't have lost such a big person.

Everyone knows such a common sense thing. The mistake I am making now is like on earth, a person said in class in front of teachers and students that the earth under his feet is flat.

So what, during the new book period, keep it in your collection, and if you have tickets, buy them actively.
